# rixl_feed (Data Source)

Retrieves configuration, description, and status of a content feed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rixl_feed" "main" {
  project_id = var.rixl_project_id
  id         = var.rixl_feed_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `allow_images` (Boolean)
- `allow_videos` (Boolean)
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. "2024-12-25T12:00:00Z".
- `description` (String)
- `has_comments` (Boolean)
- `has_likes` (Boolean)
- `has_shares` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. "2024-12-25T12:00:00Z".
